note: STAND-IN. The record layout is proposed in ACTIVATION.md at commit 4d9d66e.
No producer release writes the record yet. This file has no signature.
record_kind is the kind of the signed record that a release will give.
A later change must pin a release that writes the record, replace these stand-ins with records from that release, and update the mapping and the rule checks if needed.
All values are synthetic and neutral. The five reference values are hashes of distinct sample library texts and do not come from the example content.
names: A value that starts with `$` is a name. Bind candidate.ref and a nonempty base to the SHA-256 reference of the exact content manifest bytes. The consumer maps that reference to its store candidate or published snapshot.
